description: Every shop's price for a video game on Vouchernaut (UK accounts): official stores (Steam, PlayStation Store, Xbox, Nintendo eShop and the like) first, then key shops, for one platform and edition. Each price includes the fee the shop's feed gives, says key or download and its region, and warns where a key may not work on a UK account; each has a tracked link to the shop. A shop's discount code is never given, only its price with the code and the page that shows it.

edition.description: An edition ("Deluxe"); the standard one if left out

game.description: The game, by name ("Elden Ring"), slug or vouchernaut.com/games page address

key_shops.description: Include key resellers and marketplaces (on by default)

limit.description: Shops to return, in the page's order

platform.description: A platform it's sold for ("PlayStation", "Steam", "Xbox", "Nintendo"); the first listed if left out

name: game_prices
title: Compare a game's prices
